page.layout: One page of running text, one full-width column. Running head at the top. No margin notes. A verse stanza of two lines centred below the text. A centred heading with an italic title line at the foot of the text.

main_text.p: ex parte agat, eum, tanquam Epitomen cō-cionis Obadiæ adscribā: Recordare Iehouah filiorum Edom, diei Hierusalem, qui dice-bant: Discooperite, discooperite, vsq; ad fundamentum in ea.

p.i: Quemadmodum autem Edomita, impla-cabiles Iudaorum hostes, metropolin istorū funditus deleri, gentemq; ad extrema redi-gi, cupiebant: sic falsi fratres, Ecclesiam fide-lium eum ad modum oderunt, vt frigidam, quod dici consueuit, manifestis hostibus eius suffundant, sauitiam eorum acuant, mutuas operas eisdem tradant: malintq; cum lupis istis vlulare, quàm cum orthodoxa Ecclesia doxologias de laudibus Dei, cantare.

main_text.p: Sed tamen, vt olim Chaldaïs & Idumæis pereuntibus, Iudaicus populus quasi postli-minij iure in patriam reuersus est, Dei auspi-cijs: sic intereuntibus & in nihilum redactis Ecclesia perduellibus tam profanis illis quàm domesticis, Ecclesia diu oppressa tandem emer-git, & latum Paana canens, ait:

Presta sub ingenti ceu pondere palma uirescit,
Sub cruce sic florent dedita corda Deo.
main_text.head: FORMALIS CAVSA. Concio Obadiæ quatuor principibus par-tibus

page.notes: Page type is text. The printed head reads "PROLEGOMENA" and the page number is a small "10" with some doubt, marked [?]. The verse line "Presfa sub ingenti" is read as "Presta" with [?] advised for the first word of the stanza; the printed form may be "Presfa", which I have not written, so please check it against the scan. "Paana" is copied as printed, though "Paeana" is likely. "Chaldaïs" is copied with the diaeresis as seen. "metropolin" and "vlulare" are copied as printed. The stanza is written as one paragraph with a line break. The heading line "Concio Obadiæ quatuor principibus par-tibus" is italic and sits at the foot of the text, so it is joined to the heading. The printed hyphens at line ends are kept. No catchword or signature is visible.
